 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    comps=[]; seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color=grid[r][c]
            if color==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and grid[ny][nx]==color and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
            comps.append((color,cells))
    # Pick the L-shaped marker component.
    marker=None
    for color,cells in comps:
        rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
        if len(cells)>=7 and len(set(rs))>=3 and len(set(cs))>=3 and (len(cells)==len(set(rs))+len(set(cs))-1):
            marker=(color,cells); break
    if marker is None: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    mc,ms=marker
    mr=min(r for r,c in ms); mc0=min(c for r,c in ms)
    # find repeated silhouettes, and take the instance in the quadrant opposite
    # the two arms of the L (outside its corner).
    groups={}
    for color,cells in comps:
        if color==mc: continue
        r0=min(r for r,c in cells); c0=min(c for r,c in cells)
        shape=frozenset((r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in cells)
        groups.setdefault(shape,[]).append(cells)
    candidates=[]
    for shape,parts in groups.items():
        if len(parts)<2: continue
        for cells in parts:
            cr=sum(r for r,c in cells)/len(cells); cc=sum(c for r,c in cells)/len(cells)
            if cr<mr and cc<mc0:
                candidates.append(cells)
    if not candidates: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    target=min(candidates,key=lambda cells:(max(r for r,c in cells)-min(r for r,c in cells),len(cells)))
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c in target: out[r][c]=marker[0]
    return out
